title: The Ranger Who Wouldn't Stop
description: NCR Ranger Harlan Voss — Jax's father. He is not here. He is present only through what he left behind: holotapes, notes, and evidence of a man who traded everything for one more lead.
backstory: NCR Ranger Harlan Voss served the Colorado for thirty-one years with a spotless record. Then his son Jax vanished in 2277 during a Vault-Tec contractor job, and Harlan abandoned his post, his pension, and eventually his safety to follow the trail. He walked into radiation zones the NCR wouldn't authorize. He left holotapes at each location, as if Jax might someday follow them backward. He was never confirmed dead. Only absent. The tapes were all that remained.

harlan_tape01.text: This is NCR Ranger Harlan Voss. If you're hearing this... I'm still looking for my boy. Jax, if you're out there... I won't stop.

harlan_tape02.text: Jax was here. I found his pack. Blood on the rocks. I'm close now... closer than ever.

harlan_tape03.text: I saw them. Vault-Tec. They moved Jax's body into the canyon. I'm going after them. If I don't make it... tell him I tried.

harlan_note01.text: Jax — I found your trail again. I won't give up. Not now. Not ever.

harlan_finalnote.text: If anyone finds this... follow the trail. My son is still out there. I won't stop. Not until I bring him home.

harlan_memory_echo.text: Jax... I swear I'll find you. Even if it kills me.

harlan_ghoul_variant.text: I ain't what I used to be... but I still remember my boy.
